# Vidhu P Vinod — Personal Perspectives & Essays

> An online collection of essays, personal world views, mental models, and reflections on technology, human agency, urbanism, and modern systems by Vidhu P Vinod.

## Core Site Information
- Author: Vidhu P Vinod
- Main Portfolio Website: https://vidhuvinod.netlify.app/
- Primary Themes: Urbanism, Systems, Technology, Philosophy, Mindset, Decision Making

## Featured Essays
- [Global Liveability Index or Expat Allowance Calculator?](/post/global-liveability-index-or-expat-allowance-calculator): An objective critique of the EIU Global Liveability Index—exposing why a corporate tool designed for expat hardship allowances should not be used by media headlines to judge civic quality of life.
